calibration.status: All 32 printed block roofs/sides and card texts inspected in native crops; full-page route crops reviewed against 245x103 rendering. No nonstandard bank shift applied.

source_coverage.evidence: Native 10200x6600 TIFF overview and all seven bank/row crops, plus 32 individually enlarged block crops and four node atlases; every printed block/card/pin label, grid/ID line and open lower edge checked. Nearby long horizontal strokes are separately routed wires or the roof of the next box.
Native upper/middle/lower route crops and targeted crossings traced to 35 semantic nets, including both four-way buses, 20 right-hand outputs, and 29 open diamonds.
Native right-upper/right-lower crops inspected at full resolution; all RT destinations transcribed in printed row order beside the 20 terminal signals.
Native title/footer and enlarged connector-table crops checked; title diamond, dates, machine, part, block, both revisions, and all eight connector rows retained.

review_notes.evidence: RT921 TIFF SHA-256 186CC5F397426BD6B1F46D50606AE6C3B08FB0DE246D868409E3C0CC51D384B2; native 10200x6600. Fixed 245x103 cell grid; regular seven-bank positions; no shifted bank.
Native 4x enlargement shows B03 followed by the vertical BE D05 wire crossing; the cross is not an open asterisk. Both nets remain unjoined at the crossing.

Enlarged AS, AG and AK native crops show a printed grid/ID line after the location row, with no horizontal bottom border. The long stroke under AS and AK extends past the sides and is an independent passing wire; AG has no lower stroke. All 32 gates retain open lower edges and their native grid/ID lines.

Native enlarged table prints AW4 for B-C4M1B11 and 02B-C3M8B06, while A1 indexes the same two contacts as AU4. It prints BE4 for B-B4E1D11 and 02B-B3E8D06, while A1 indexes them as BB4. Literal scan readings are retained; these four A1 mismatches are unresolved source disagreements, not inferred corrections.

Compared native page overview and enlarged junction/output/table crops with the final JuliaMono preview. All printed node positions, outbound rails, destination-reference groups and footer/table zones were inspected.

All diagram card and connector print was inspected on the native scan. Literal source values are retained; unmatched A1 page-index entries are reported separately from geometry validation. A1 provides no local wire ownership.
